name: api.js
summary: Frontend HTTP client module that centralizes API communication with backend services
purpose: Provides a unified, reusable interface for making authenticated HTTP requests from the frontend to backend APIs, abstracting away fetch/axios complexity, handling auth tokens, and normalizing request/response formats
responsibilities: Define and manage the base API URL configuration
Construct complete request URLs from endpoint paths
Attach standard and authentication headers to requests
Execute HTTP requests and handle responses
Normalize error handling and response parsing
architecture_notes: Serves as an API Gateway / Facade pattern at the frontend boundary, isolating the application from direct fetch/axios usage. Centralizes cross-cutting concerns such as authentication header injection, base URL resolution, and payload serialization. This design prevents duplication across feature modules and allows global changes to networking behavior (e.g., adding interceptors, switching HTTP libraries) without refactoring consumer code.
improvements: Add request and response interceptors for logging and global error handling
Implement request deduplication or cancellation using AbortController
Add exponential backoff retry logic for transient network failures
Introduce TypeScript interfaces for type-safe API contracts
Extract API_BASE_URL into environment-specific configuration files
Add comprehensive request/response validation schemas (e.g., Zod)
Implement circuit breaker pattern for resilience against backend outages
